files.project/components/Notice/README.md:
News that stays on the page until it is no longer true: a launch, a roast day, a delivery window. A toast confirms what the person did; a notice tells them something they did not ask.

- **Seasonal** is a `honey-soft` wash with `ink` copy, for First Light and other launches. **Plain** sits on `surface-raised` with a `line`.
- A title of a few words, one sentence under it, one link at most. The link is `text-link`, so it follows the accent.
- One notice per screen, above the content it is about. Never stack two.
- You provide `title`, `children` and, if there is somewhere to go, `link`.
